summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $7.6B in SPX BuyCalls versus only $1.9B in BuyPuts. The most significant conviction is seen in massive SPX 7000C accumulations for 2026 and 2027, with single-contract clusters exceeding $2.3B, suggesting a "buy the dip" strategy for long-term indices. Persistent multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C (over $4B in the 2027 expiry) and SPX 8000P (nearly $3B in the 2026 expiry) indicates institutions are simultaneously hedging tail risk while betting on sustained upward momentum. Traders should watch for continued strength in mega-cap tech (AAPL, META, NVDA) given the extreme low Put/Call ratios (0.06–0.65) and monitor if the heavy SPX 7000C buying triggers a volatility squeeze.
